summary: YPF S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K a translation of its October 5, 2026 letter to Argentina's CNV (the local equivalent of an SEC current report), reporting open-market repurchases of its Class XXVII Notes (YMCTO) between September 28 and October 2, 2026. Total consideration was Ps. 6,660,251,170.56 for US$4,374,760 par value, an average price of 99.91% of nominal. The notes, issued October 2023 under the Frequent Issuer framework at US$127,904,997 nominal and maturing October 2026, will be held in treasury. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch remaining float and any further buybacks ahead of maturity.
